description: Committed baseline for the evaluation harness. Each metric records the current measured value with an explicit tolerance. The harness diffs a fresh run against this file; a metric outside tolerance fails, a metric inside tolerance passes.
scope: Mechanical regression gate only — not a linguistic quality verdict (ADR-0204/0211 Draft)

search.golden_agreement.description: Fraction of golden queries whose reference set matches the service output

search.empty_result_rate.description: Fraction of queries that returned zero hits (must be 0 on the fixture)

search.determinism.description: Fraction of queries whose output is byte-identical across two runs

lexicon.attribution_completeness.description: Fraction of lexicon results that carry dataset attribution

lexicon.typed_unavailable.description: Fraction of no-dataset calls that return the typed QAI-MORPH-0004 error

lexicon.determinism.description: Fraction of lexicon calls whose output is byte-identical across two runs
